finding.summary: Razor section rendering probes the rendered-section set twice for a new section.
finding.explanation: RenderSectionAsyncCore tests _renderedSections.Contains(sectionName) and, after finding the render delegate, adds the same name to the same HashSet<string>. A successfully rendered new section pays separate membership and insertion probes. Use Add's Boolean result on the found-section path, but preserve the original duplicate-section exception precedence and the missing required/optional section behavior. In particular, do not unconditionally add the name before delegate lookup: an absent optional section must remain unrecorded. The set uses StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase, which must be retained.
finding.recommended_fix: Use Add's Boolean result on the found-section path rather than a separate membership probe followed by insertion.
finding.compatibility_notes: Preserve the case-insensitive comparer, duplicate-error precedence, and missing required/optional section behavior. Do not record missing optional sections as rendered.
